title: Sting’s Squadron vs. the Dangerous Alliance
summary: Paul E. Dangerously assembles a faction to dominate WCW. Sting’s allies band together against its attacks, with the struggle culminating in WarGames.

chapters.title: Rude takes advantage of an injured Sting
chapters.result: Rude defeats Sting for the United States title after Luger attacks Sting’s knee.
chapters.context: The ambush gives Dangerously’s emerging faction an important championship advantage.

chapters.title: Sting’s side wins WarGames
chapters.result: Sting’s Squadron defeats the Dangerous Alliance.
chapters.context: A mistake within the Alliance leaves Eaton vulnerable, giving Sting’s coalition the cage-match payoff.
